email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with passed out
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 31-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their first dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 25mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-07-06.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed passed out.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
P. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter678@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
